requirement: The spacecraft shall downlink at least 1.2 Gbit of science data per day.
The spacecraft shall maintain pointing accuracy of 0.1 deg (3 sigma) during science operations.
The transmitter shall provide a downlink data rate of at least 2 Mbps.
The C&DH shall store at least 4 Gbit of science data.
The star tracker shall provide attitude at no less than 5 Hz.
The structure shall provide two spare payload mounting points.
The flight software shall use the project coding standard FSW-STD-01.
The reaction wheels shall provide at least 4 mNms of momentum storage.
The ADCS shall estimate attitude with an error of no more than 0.05 deg (3 sigma).
